detail.title: Intrinsic Limits of Self-Correction in Reasoning Models
detail.summary: Recent literature indicates that models struggle with intrinsic self-correction without external validation signals, pointing to foundational limitations in current reasoning paradigms.
detail.reason: Publishing initial notebook findings based on collected literature for assumption challenge.

detail.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project focus on assumption challenge and reasoning bounds.
